title: Rime Prism S2S
description: Shortcut for 'llm' with vendor automatically set to 'rime'. Connects the caller to Rime Prism, a speech-to-speech model (English only), for real-time voice conversation. Prism finds the end of each turn itself and has no model choice, so 'model' is ignored. With no 'auth', jambonz uses the account's Rime Prism (rime_s2s) speech-to-speech credential chosen by 'label'. llmOptions.session_update is sent in Prism's flat session shape; Prism refuses a whole update that has an unknown field, so only Prism's own fields are allowed. Prism speaks first only when llmOptions.response_create is given; without it, Prism waits for the caller.

vendor.description: The LLM vendor (always 'rime' for this shortcut).

auth.description: Optional. A Rime API key. When omitted, jambonz uses the account's rime_s2s credential chosen by 'label'.

apiKey.description: Rime API key, sent as a Bearer header.

connectOptions.description: Connection options, for a Prism deployment other than Rime's cloud.

host.description: The Prism host. Defaults to prism.api.rime.ai.

path.description: The websocket path. Defaults to v1/realtime.

llmOptions.description: session_update configures the Prism session; response_create, when present, makes Prism speak first.

session_update.description: Prism session settings, sent as the first session.update. jambonz adds the handoff and hangup tools when they are configured, and labels every reply with the call sid.

voice.description: The Prism voice. Defaults to astra. Rime's text-to-speech voices do not work with Prism.

instructions.description: The system prompt. Write it in plain spoken sentences, and give each tool a rule for when to call it.

tools.description: Functions Prism can ask the application to run, in either OpenAI shape (flat, or nested under 'function'). Results come back through the toolHook.

prism_filler.description: What Prism says while this tool runs: auto (a short line from the tool's description), text (your line) or none.

turn_detection.description: Prism detects turns itself; these settings tune it. eagerness and prism_end_of_turn_timeout_ms cannot change after the session starts.

interrupt_response.description: Whether the caller's speech interrupts a reply. Defaults to true.

eagerness.description: How readily Prism decides the caller has finished. low waits longer; high replies sooner.

prism_end_of_turn_timeout_ms.description: Silence that ends the caller's turn even when Prism is unsure. Defaults to 5000.

truncation.description: What Prism does when the conversation outgrows its context: auto (leave out the oldest turns), disabled, or a retention ratio.

prism_response_metadata.description: Labels copied onto every reply. Up to 16; keys up to 64 characters not starting with prism_, string values up to 512 characters. jambonz adds call_sid.

response_create.description: When present, Prism speaks first: jambonz sends a nudge with these instructions as soon as the session is ready. Omit it to wait for the caller.

instructions.description: What the opening reply should do, e.g. 'Greet the caller and ask how you can help.'

session_update.instructions: You answer the phone for Juniper Cafe. Answer in one short sentence. Call get_opening_hours before you answer a question about opening hours.

tools.name: get_opening_hours
tools.description: Today's opening hours for Juniper Cafe.

response_create.instructions: Greet the caller and ask how you can help.
